## Summary

Describe what this Pull Request changes and why.

## Change type

- [ ] New plugin or script
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Website or Worker change
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance

## Details

List the important changes and any behavior that reviewers should know about.

## Testing

Describe what you tested, including device, Studio Lite/Roblox version, browser or other relevant environment.

## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets `main`.
- [ ] New or changed `SVS.json` manifests are valid JSON.
- [ ] Every manifest file path exists and remains inside its script folder.
- [ ] Source code and assets are mine or I have permission to redistribute them.
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, tokens, private URLs or personal information are included.
- [ ] Required setup steps and known limitations are documented.
- [ ] Related documentation has been updated.
- [ ] Screenshots or evidence are attached for UI changes when practical.
